title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 170
paragraphs: Next to the Giligamae on the west are the Asbystae. These live above Cyrene, and the Asbystae do not reach down to the sea, since the coastal region is occupied by the Cyrenaeans. Of all the Libyans these are the greatest drivers of four-horse chariots, and in most of their customs they try to imitate the Cyrenaeans.
